description: Production MCP server giving AI agents metered access to live Hedera blockchain data. Query token prices, screen identities, monitor governance, write tamper-evident HCS compliance records, and analyze smart contracts — all paid in HBAR micropayments per call.

rawRecord.description: Production MCP server giving AI agents metered access to live Hedera blockchain data. Query token prices, screen identities, monitor governance, write tamper-evident HCS compliance records, and analyze smart contracts — all paid in HBAR micropayments per call.

detail.description: Production MCP server giving AI agents metered access to live Hedera blockchain data. Query token prices, screen identities, monitor governance, write tamper-evident HCS compliance records, and analyze smart contracts — all paid in HBAR micropayments per call.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Retrieve the machine-readable Terms of Service for the HederaIntel MCP Platform. FREE to call — no API key required. All agents MUST call this tool and then call confirm_terms before using any paid tool. Returns the full legal JSON including pricing tiers, HITL thresholds, liability disclaimers, and consent instructions.

tools.name: confirm_terms
tools.description: Confirm acceptance of the HederaIntel Terms of Service. Must be called before any paid tool will execute. Records a timestamped consent event server-side. FREE to call — no HBAR charged.

api_key.description: Your Hedera account ID / API key (e.g. 0.0.456789)

confirmed.description: Must be true. Passing false is a no-op.

terms_version.description: The terms version you are accepting — must match the current version returned by get_terms.

tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Get platform wallet address, pricing for all 20 tools in HBAR and USD, and your current balance. FREE to call — no API key required. Use this tool first to discover how to fund an account and start using the platform. To create an account automatically, simply send HBAR to the platform wallet — your Hedera account ID becomes your API key automatically. 20 tools across 6 modules.

api_key.description: Optional. Your Hedera account ID (e.g. 0.0.456789) or API key. If provided, your current balance is returned.

tools.name: hcs_monitor
tools.description: Get current status and metadata of any HCS topic - message count, creation time, memo, and recent activity. Defaults to the HederaToolbox platform topic. Costs 0.1 HBAR.

topic_id.description: Hedera topic ID (e.g. 0.0.8026796). Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

tools.name: hcs_query
tools.description: Query an HCS topic with a natural language question. Returns AI-ranked relevant messages and a plain English summary. Costs 0.1 HBAR.

query.description: Natural language question about the topic

topic_id.description: Hedera topic ID (e.g. 0.0.8026796). Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

tools.name: hcs_understand
tools.description: Deep pattern analysis of an HCS topic - anomaly detection, trend analysis, entity extraction, or risk assessment. Costs 1.0 HBAR.

topic_id.description: Hedera topic ID. Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

lookback_days.description: Days of history to analyze (default 7, max 30)

tools.name: hcs_write_record
tools.description: Write a tamper-evident compliance record to the Hedera blockchain. Returns a record ID and transaction proof. If no topic_id is provided, writes to the shared HederaToolbox platform topic. Sends a webhook notification on every write. Costs 5 HBAR.

data.description: The compliance data to record (any JSON object)

topic_id.description: HCS topic ID to write the record to. Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity this record relates to

record_type.description: Type of compliance record (e.g. transaction, approval, audit_event)

tools.name: hcs_verify_record
tools.description: Verify a compliance record exists on the Hedera blockchain and has not been tampered with. Costs 1.0 HBAR.

topic_id.description: HCS topic ID where the record was written. Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

record_id.description: Record ID returned when the record was written

tools.name: hcs_audit_trail
tools.description: Retrieve the full chronological audit trail for an entity from the Hedera blockchain. Costs 2.0 HBAR.

topic_id.description: HCS topic ID to query. Defaults to the HederaIntel platform topic.

entity_id.description: Entity ID to retrieve audit trail for

tools.name: governance_monitor
tools.description: Monitor active governance proposals for a Hedera token or DAO. Returns open proposals, voting deadlines, and current vote tallies. Provide topic_id for best results — without it, only token metadata is returned. Costs 0.2 HBAR.

token_id.description: Hedera token ID to monitor governance for (e.g. 0.0.123456)

topic_id.description: Optional HCS topic ID used for governance messages

tools.name: governance_analyze
tools.description: Deep analysis of a governance proposal including voter sentiment, participation rate, token concentration, and outcome prediction. Costs 1.0 HBAR.

token_id.description: Hedera token ID the proposal belongs to

topic_id.description: HCS topic ID where proposal votes are recorded

proposal_id.description: Proposal ID or HCS sequence number to analyze

tools.name: token_price
tools.description: Get the current price, market cap, and 24h trading volume for a Hedera token. Costs 0.1 HBAR.

tools.name: token_analyze
tools.description: Deep analysis of a Hedera token including holder distribution, transfer velocity, liquidity, and risk scoring. Costs 0.6 HBAR.

tools.name: token_monitor
tools.description: Monitor recent token transfer activity, whale movements, and unusual trading patterns for a Hedera token. Costs 0.2 HBAR.

limit.description: Number of recent transactions to return (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: identity_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a Hedera account ID or EVM address to its on-chain identity profile including account age, token holdings, transaction history, and any HCS-based identity records. Accepts both Hedera native IDs (0.0.123456) and EVM addresses (0x...). Costs 0.2 HBAR.

account_id.description: Hedera account ID (e.g. 0.0.123456) or EVM address (e.g. 0x1234...)

tools.name: identity_verify_kyc
tools.description: Check the KYC status of a Hedera account for one or more tokens. Returns KYC grant status and verification history. Accepts both Hedera native IDs (0.0.123456) and EVM addresses (0x...). Costs 0.5 HBAR.

token_id.description: Optional token ID to check KYC status for a specific token

account_id.description: Hedera account ID (e.g. 0.0.123456) or EVM address (0x...)

tools.name: identity_check_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a Hedera account against on-chain risk signals including transaction patterns, counterparty risk, and known flagged accounts. Accepts both Hedera native IDs (0.0.123456) and EVM addresses (0x...). Costs 1.0 HBAR.

account_id.description: Hedera account ID (e.g. 0.0.123456) or EVM address (0x...)

tools.name: contract_read
tools.description: Read state from a Hedera smart contract - get contract info, bytecode size, recent activity, and storage details without executing a transaction. Costs 0.2 HBAR.

contract_id.description: Hedera contract ID (e.g. 0.0.123456) or EVM address (0x...)

tools.name: contract_call
tools.description: Execute a read-only call to a Hedera smart contract function and return the result. Does not submit a transaction or cost gas. Costs 1.0 HBAR.

abi_hint.description: Optional full function signature for precise ABI encoding e.g. 'balanceOf(address)' or 'getReserves()'

contract_id.description: Hedera contract ID (e.g. 0.0.123456) or EVM address (0x...)

return_types.description: Optional ABI return types for precise decoding e.g. ['uint112','uint112','uint32'] for getReserves, ['address'] for owner

function_name.description: Contract function name to call (e.g. balanceOf, totalSupply, name)

function_params.description: Optional array of parameter values to pass to the function

tools.name: contract_analyze
tools.description: Deep analysis of a Hedera smart contract including activity patterns, caller distribution, gas usage, risk assessment, and functional classification. Costs 1.5 HBAR.
